candidates.change_summary: Replace `return true;` with `return false;` so the function returns false instead of true on successful completion.
Remove the require that enforces msg.sender check, allowing any caller to invoke transfer.
Remove the require that checks _tos.length > 0, allowing empty array calls.
Delete the return true statement at the end, so the function returns the default false.
Remove the for loop body so no external calls are made, yet function still returns true.
Replace mul_uint256 scaling factor 1000000000000000000 with 0, sending zero tokens.
Replace caddress with address(0) so the call always fails (or burns), changing outcome.
